name: GroundUI-1K
description: A subset of GroundUI-18K for UI grounding evaluation, where models must predict action coordinates on screenshots based on single-step instructions across web, desktop, and mobile platforms.
reputation: A small UI grounding subset used in research on action localization, with limited standalone community adoption compared with larger UI benchmarks.
notes: Subset benchmark derived from GroundUI-18K; likely limited size and may be sensitive to screenshot/task overlap with training data.
